mapper.sql: id, type, direct_user_low, direct_user_high, group_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_conversation (id, type, direct_user_low, direct_user_high, group_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{type}, #{directUserLow}, #{directUserHigh}, #{groupId}, NOW(), NOW(), 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE deleted = 0, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_conversation WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM t_conversation WHERE type = 2 AND group_id = #{groupId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE t_conversation SET deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
